name: EHL Hospitality Business School
summary: Private hospitality business school in Lausanne; one four-year bachelor, a BSc (HES-SO) in hospitality management, taught in English or French.

ib.text: Full IB Diploma, 28/42 minimum with priority from 30 (September 2026 to February 2029 intakes). Maths, a natural science and an HL in business, economics, science or maths are preferred. IB in English meets the C1 rule.

dates.label: Application deadline if you need a visa, September 2027 intake

programmes.name: Bachelor in International Hospitality Management
programmes.ib: Online interview, aptitude tests and a final interview after the file is reviewed; the Preparatory Year is taught only in English.
programmes.about: A preparatory year of hands-on service and kitchen training, then business foundations, two six-month internships (operations and administration), an optional Singapore semester and a final-year specialisation such as luxury marketing or finance and real estate.
programmes.selectionNote: File review with your essay, then a 20-minute online interview and an aptitude test, then a final interview on motivation and fit. 30+ IB points gets priority.

notes: You can apply on predicted grades for a conditional offer; ask the IB to send your final results to EHL, institution code 002346.
From the September 2029 intake the minimum rises to 30 points, and the subject pattern becomes a requirement.
The degree awarded is a Bachelor of Science (HES-SO), and one semester can be spent at EHL's Singapore campus.
